exposure: Anencephalic fetus in pregnancies continued to term
cohort: 28 pregnancies with a prenatal diagnosis of anencephaly that were not terminated
finding: Continuing pregnancies with an anencephalic fetus to term was associated with a high rate of stillbirths (32%), polyhydramnios requiring amniodrainage in some cases, and risks of labor induction, Cesarean delivery, and shoulder dystocia.
mod_finding: The study found that vaginal birth was achieved in 67% of pregnancies carried to term with an anencephalic fetus.
gest_age: Average gestational age at diagnosis: 18 weeks, average gestational age at birth: 31 weeks (range 23-37 weeks)
